porifera.definition: n coextensive with the subkingdom Parazoa: sponges
porifera.translation: [医] 多孔动物门(海绵动物门)

poriferan.definition: n primitive multicellular marine animal whose porous body is supported by a fibrous skeletal framework; usually occurs in sessile colonies

poriferous.definition: a full of pores or vessels or holes
poriferous.translation: a. 有孔的, 多孔的, 多孔动物的

poriform.definition: a. Resembling a pore, or small puncture.

poring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Pore
poring.translation: vi. 细看（pore的现在分词形式）

porism.definition:
n. A proposition affirming the possibility of finding such
   conditions as will render a certain determinate problem indeterminate
   or capable of innumerable solutions.
n. A corollary.
porism.translation: n. 不定设题, 系论

porites.definition:
n. An important genus of reef-building corals having small
   twelve-rayed calicles, and a very porous coral. Some species are
   branched, others grow in large massive or globular forms.
